lines.text: A newlywed couple...?

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Yep, that's right. No need to act so shocked. You heard me right.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: The target occasionally attends gatherings other than the ones she hosts.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: They are gatherings exclusive solely for Sovereigns,

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: so we'll disguise ourselves accordingly

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: as Sovereigns...
Is there a reason why we have to be a couple?

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: It's easier to make a background story if we do that.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: It's more convenient and avoids suspicion in various ways.
Even if there are two wives?

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: What do you mean by "two wives"?

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: I'll be acting alone this time since we have to investigate the missing people.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Therefore, D will play the role of a wife.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: You'll need to stay elsewhere for a while.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Going back and forth between the Outpost will be too suspicious.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: A house has already been prepared.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Disguise tools have been prepared for you as well, so make good use of them.

lines.speaker: k
lines.text: Since you're a famous figure in the Ark, make sure that no one recognizes you.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: All right, I'll be back at the same time tomorrow.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Make sure you're ready to don your crown.
The next day.
I examine my reflection in the mirror.
With a wig, an expensive suit, and glasses, it seems no one will recognize me.
But just in case, I even put on a mask.
Great. That's perfect.
D will be here soon.
*Zing*
Erm... Who are you?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's me.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Why are you staring at me so intently...?
Because you look so beautiful.
Because you seem like a totally different person.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: ... Thanks.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Of course, I seem like a different person. I'm in a disguise.
How do I look?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Unrecognizable.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: You've disguised yourself well.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: But I think you should take off the mask.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It hides your face too much.
Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's not a problem, but it'll be distracting when gathering intel.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: People are always wary of those who hide their faces or try not to show themselves.
I heed D's advice and take off my mask.
What do I need to do now, then?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: First, let's move to the residence at the Ark.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll explain everything there.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's here.
The spacious house is filled with expensive-looking decorations and furniture.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's a luxurious apartment where Sovereigns are known to gather and live.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Apparently, they demolished all the old buildings and facilities in this area and rebuilt everything.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Thanks to that, the Sovereigns are very fond of it now.
How did you manage to get such a nice place?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I can't tell you all the details.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We'll stay here for a while and approach the target.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Our first goal is to perk the target's interest, and get an invite to a social gathering.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: In order to achieve that, we'll participate in every gathering that the target attends for a while.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: And here, take this.
*Slide*
D hands me a tablet.
What's this?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Read it.
Dated for about 10 years and got married a month ago.
Became wealthy due to a recent successful business venture...?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: That's our background story.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: In order to act naturally in any situation, it'll be good to memorize as much of it as possible.
The tablet contains very detailed and densely written stories about our past.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: If there's anything you don't understand or are curious about, feel free to ask.
I have a question.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Shoot.
Did you personally write this?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Yep.
Even this "very submissive to husband's demands" part?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: ... Yep.
Even the "her most favorite flowers are the ones her husband buys her" part...?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Is there a problem?
No, it's just...
It seems like you wrote down even the smallest... details.
We prepare some gifts to greet our neighbors and get to know them.
It's not a lot.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Since it's the most high-end apartment,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: many Sovereigns can't move in because of the price.
Huh...? It smells of flowers here.
After looking around, I see red diffusers placed throughout the corridor.
Wow, they even have things like that here.
Luxury apartments are truly unique.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Watch your reaction. There are people approaching.
Where?
D casually links her arm to mine.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Oh, Honey.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I wonder what our neighbors are like.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'm so excited!
The moment the words left D's mouth, a woman emerges from the corner.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I haven't seen you before. Are you the one who just moved in?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's great to see you here. I was planning to visit you anyway.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Are you the residents' representative chairman?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I remember hearing that you'd come to visit us.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I never imagined that such a young couple would move in here!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: You're almost my age. It's nice to meet you!
No matter how I look, she doesn't look our age. I guess I'll just try to laugh it off.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's nice to meet you too!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Actually, my husband recently achieved huge success with his business.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Haha, having a lot of money is certainly nice, especially moving to such a nice place like this

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: and even being neighbors with someone as fantastic as you!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I look forward to hanging out with you.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Success in business...?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Haha, I'm thrilled to have such beautiful neighbors.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: But, what are you holding?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Oh, we almost forgot!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's a gift!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We got it for our neighbors. It's a flower!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my... a flower?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Yes, it's called a preserved flower.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: A living flower that's been treated with preservatives, so that it won't wither for a long time.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my, a real live flower? Are you really giving me such a precious gift?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Of course! You'll be our long-term neighbors, after all!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Thank you, I love flowers.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's very pretty. Like me, haha! Thank you.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's not much of a gift, but I wanted to give you this as well.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Here...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's a diffuser. You see the ones in the corridor? It's the same one.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It has a floral scent that's just lovely.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I thought it would be nice to have at home, so I brought it with me.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We just happen to need one of those!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Don't mention it. If you have any questions or need any help, feel free to talk to me.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's good to be friendly with neighbors.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Since we're on the topic, we're struggling to widen our social circle.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Perhaps it's because we married early, but single people often find us a little daunting to approach.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's also hard to meet people with similar hobbies and interests.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Also...
D blushes and leans in closer to me.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: My husband likes being with me too much.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Because we're always together, it's harder to meet new people.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my, Just like my husband and I!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: My husband can't do anything without me either.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: He has to attend all my gatherings with me like a child... Ah!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Then, why don't you attend gatherings as a couple?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I just happen to know a gathering for couples, actually.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: They meet up, build friendships, and talk about what's happening in the world.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: We also discuss business matters...

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: My husband has been so busy recently, so I haven't been out in a while. But if you're interested, I can recommend you.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: If you could do that for us, we'd really appreciate it!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: That's amazing, Honey!
Yeah... It's great.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Here's my business card. Just take it with you.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Is this all I need to bring?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I'm quite well-known around here!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Everyone knows me, hehehe.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I'll contact you separately with the details.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Wow, thank you so much.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: You've shown us so much kindness. We don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: How can we repay you?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Just invite me over next time

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: and share some tips on how you earned so much money in business.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: My husband is also a very famous businessman!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: He's probably in the top three in the Ark?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Of course, it might be difficult to invite you over now since we haven't fully unpacked yet.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: But we'll invite you as soon as we've sorted everything out.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: All right, see you soon.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Yes, we'll see you again soon!
The chairman takes her leave with a smile.
You're great at acting.
So, should we head back too? Honey?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Ssh, talk more quietly.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Other Sovereigns are living here,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: so we gotta be careful what we say here.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: About the whole "Honey" nickname...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: You don't need to use it when it's just the two of us.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Let's quickly check out the other places too.
